scope: Six owner protocol product/formal-test files only. Other manifest inputs are dependency/spec/task/config provenance, not a claim of whole-repository manual review. Generated route belongs to root verification.

files.note: Reviewed complete body initially and quality-repaired diff: exact partial format, owned graph/path closure, Unicode-sensitive canonical revision/wire, mutable input ownership, bounded incremental digest, private prepared certification, defensive receive snapshots and cancellation.

Reviewed complete body initially and every repaired diff: trusted registry/session/capabilities, content-addressed staging, stale/race branch retention, frozen operation inputs, lifecycle after callbacks, CAS/runtime receipt identity and truthful atomic commit outcomes.

Reviewed complete meaningful fixture tests: canonical Unicode permutations, strict fields/owners/coverage, mutable metadata/buffer snapshots, source read faults, chunk/macroturn evidence and final cancellation. No assertion-free body mirroring accepted.

Reviewed complete tests and repaired additions: actual independently rooted devices/bytes/ledger, races/stale candidates, forged preparation, retries/failure, before/after commit cancellation, capability closure and malformed return outcomes.

Reviewed complete actual map/queue/immutable transport implementation, including synchronous record/file/ledger commit and signal check after asynchronous before-commit staging. Native/filesystem durability is excluded.
Reviewed complete configuration extending application strict settings and including formal protocol/provider tests/helper; independently supplemented by checker strict config.
